chunks: Do they not ponder over the Qur'an? Had it been from other than Allah, they would surely have found in it much variation.
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of the Qur'an's divine origin according to Surah An-Nisa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Ayat al-Tadabbur) is often cited to emphasize that the Qur'an's internal consistency (nazm) serves as a rational proof of its divine origin, inviting believers to engage in deep contemplation rather than superficial reading. Scholars highlight that the 'discrepancies' mentioned refer to logical contradictions or thematic inconsistencies that would arise from multiple human authors, thereby affirming the Qur'an's unity as a miracle accessible to all levels of intellect.
